MISSION

MAONO:
Mitaa yote ya Manispaa na Halmashauri (LGAs) katika Mkoa wa Arusha iendeshwe vizuri kwa maendeleo endelevu yanayolenga kupunguza umaskini na kukuza ukuaji wa uchumi.
DHIMA
Ofisi ya Mkoa itajitahidi kutoa huduma bora, kwa wakati na endelevu kwa wateja wake na kutoa kiunganishi imara kati ya Serikali Kuu, Mitaa na Halmashauri (LGAs) na wadau wengine huku ikikuza sera ya Utawala wa Kati kwa Uwezo wa Mitaa.

pages.title: Our History
pages.text_en:
Arusha Region is among 26 Regions in Tanzania and officially it was established in 1963 as an administrative Region in Tanzania.
Before 1963, the Arusha area was part of the Northern Province during the colonial period and early independence, after administrative adjustments of the Government, with its Headquarters in Arusha City.
In 1967, the First President of the United Republic of Tanzania, Mwl. Julius Kambarage Nyerere, declared the Ujamaa and Self-Reliance Policy through the Arusha Declaration, an event that made Arusha an important part of the nation's history and the Headquarters of the Arusha Declaration.
Arusha Region is located between Latitude 2.5 to 4.0 South and Longitude 35.5 to 37.8 East, covering an area of approximately 37,576 square kilometers, with much of the area being plains, mountains, and wildlife conservation areas.
Furthermore, the Arusha Region has 6 Districts: Arusha, Arumeru, Monduli, Karatu, Longido, and Ngorongoro, and 7 Councils: Arusha City, Arusha, Meru, Monduli, Karatu, Longido, and Ngorongoro, along with 7 Electoral Constituencies. The Arusha Region has a total of 23 Divisions, 158 Wards, 154 Streets, 393 Villages, and 1,471 Hamlets, with the residents of the region being mainly from the Meru, Arusha (who are related to the Maasai community), and Maasai ethnic groups.
The economic activities of the inhabitants of the Arusha Region include livestock keeping, farming, tourism, large and small industries, trade, and entrepreneurship.
﻿The Arusha Region has also been a hub of Diplomacy and Regional Cooperation. For example, the headquarters of the East African Community is in Arusha, and it also hosted the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda, which operated in Arusha after the Rwandan Genocide.
﻿The Arusha Region is a major tourism center (close to Serengeti National Park and Ngorongoro Conservation Area) and a hub for international conferences in East Africa.
pages.text_sw:
Mkoa wa Arusha ni kati ya Mikoa 26 Nchini Tanzania na rasmi Mkoa huu ulianzishwa mwaka 1963 kama Mkoa wa utawala nchini Tanzania.
Kabla ya mwaka 1963, eneo la Arusha lilikuwa sehemu ya Mkoa wa Kaskazini wakati wa enzi ya ukoloni na mwanzo wa uhuru, baada ya marekebisho ya kiutawala ya Serikali, na Makao Makuu yake yakiwa katika Jiji la Arusha.
Mwaka 1967, Rais wa Kwanza wa Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania, Mwl. Julius Kambarage Nyerere, alitangaza Sera ya Ujamaa na Kujitegemea kupitia Tamko la Arusha, tukio lililofanya Arusha kuwa sehemu muhimu ya historia ya taifa na Makao Makuu ya Tamko la Arusha.
Mkoa wa Arusha upo kati ya Latitudo 2.5 hadi 4.0 Kusini na Longitudo 35.5 hadi 37.8 Mashariki, ukiwa na eneo la takriban kilomita za mraba 37,576, ambapo sehemu kubwa ya eneo hilo ni misitu, milima, na maeneo ya uhifadhi wa wanyamapori.
Zaidi ya hayo, Mkoa wa Arusha una Wilaya 6: Arusha, Arumeru, Monduli, Karatu, Longido, na Ngorongoro, na Halmashauri 7: Jiji la Arusha, Arusha, Meru, Monduli, Karatu, Longido, na Ngorongoro, pamoja na Viti vya Uchaguzi 7. Mkoa wa Arusha una Jumla ya Mikoa 23, Kata 158, Mitaa 154, Vijiji 393, na Vitongoji 1,471, huku wakazi wa mkoa huo wakitokana hasa na makundi ya kabila la Meru, Arusha (ambayo ina uhusiano na jamii ya Maasai), na Maasai. Shughuli za kiuchumi za wakazi wa Mkoa wa Arusha ni pamoja na ufugaji wa mifugo, kilimo, utalii, viwanda vikubwa na vidogo, biashara, na ujasiriamali. Mkoa wa Arusha pia umekuwa kitovu cha Diplomasi na Ushirikiano wa Kanda. Kwa mfano, makao makuu ya Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki yapo Arusha, na pia ulikaribisha Mahakama ya Kimataifa ya Uhalifu ya Rwanda, iliyofanya kazi huko Arusha baada ya Mauaji ya Kimbari ya Rwanda.
﻿ Mkoa wa Arusha ni kituo kikuu cha utalii (karibu na Hifadhi ya Taifa ya Serengeti na Eneo la Hifadhi la Ngorongoro) na kitovu cha mikutano ya kimataifa katika Afrika Mashariki

pages.title: Arusha City District
City Council
pages.text_en:
The Arusha City Council is located in northern Tanzania, slightly south of Mount Meru at an altitude of 1,500 meters above sea level. The rapidly growing town of Arusha has long been a gateway to East Africa's famous tourist attractions such as National Parks and Maasai culture; it is now also a popular center for international meetings, gatherings, and conferences. For several years, Arusha has been a trading center for Tanzanite; a unique gemstone mined in northern Tanzania.
The town has a history that began in the 19th century when Captain Johannes built a fort at the foot of Mount Meru to facilitate German colonization of what later became known as Tanganyika. From the small fort, which still stands and has been converted into a natural history museum, the town of Arusha grew; initially as a trading center for the local people, and now into a popular center. Soma zaidi
pages.text_sw:
Halmashauri ya Jiji la Arusha iko kaskazini mwa Tanzania, chini kidogo ya Mlima Meru kwenye mwinuko wa mita 1,500 juu ya usawa wa bahari. Mji unaokua kwa kasi wa Arusha kwa muda mrefu umekuwa lango bora la vivutio maarufu vya utalii vya Afrika Mashariki kama vile Mbuga za Kitaifa, utamaduni wa Wamasai; sasa pia ni kituo maarufu cha mikutano ya Kimataifa, mikusanyiko, na makongamano. Kwa miaka kadhaa Arusha imekuwa kituo cha biashara cha Tanzanite; Jiwe la kipekee la Vito linalochimbwa kaskazini mwa Tanzania .
Mji huu una historia iliyoanza katika Karne ya 19 wakati Kapteni Johannes alipojenga ngome chini ya Mlima Meru ili kuwezesha ukoloni wa Wajerumani wa kile ambacho baadaye kilijulikana kama Tanganyika. Kutoka kwa ngome ndogo, ambayo bado imesimama na imebadilishwa kuwa jumba la kumbukumbu la historia ya asili, mji wa Arusha ulikua; kwanza kama kituo cha biashara kwa watu wa eneo hilo, na sasa katika kituo maarufu cha shughuli mbalimbali za kimataifa.

pages.title: Meru District Council
pages.text_en:
The Meru District Council was officially established by Government Notice No. 353 of 2007 following the decision to split the former Arumeru District Council and establish two independent District Councils of Meru and Arusha.
Meru District Council is located in the eastern part of Arusha Region and lies between latitudes 36°43’16’’ and 37°03’43’’; and longitude -3°04’30’’. Meru District Council borders Longido District to the north, Siha and Hai Districts to the east (Kilimanjaro Region), Simanjiro District to the south (Manyara Region), and Arusha District and Arusha District Council to the west.
pages.text_sw:
Halmashauri ya wilaya ya Meru imeanzishwa rasmi kwa Tangazo la serikali Namba 353 ya mwaka 2007 kufuatia uamuzi wa kugawa iliyokuwa Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Arumeru na kuanzisha Halmashauri mbili za Wilaya zinazojitegemea za Meru na Arusha
Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Meru ipo Mashariki mwa mkoa wa Arusha na imelala kati ya latitudi 36o43’16’’ na 37o 03’43’’; na Longitudi -3o04’30’’Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Meru inapakana na Wilaya ya Longido kwa upande wa Kaskazini, Wilaya za Siha na Hai kwa upande wa Mashariki (Mkoa wa Kilimanjaro), Wilaya ya Simanjiro kwa upande wa Kusini (Mkoa wa Manyara), na Wilaya ya Arusha na Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Arusha kwa upande wa Magharibi.

pages.title: Monduli District Council
pages.text_en:
History of Monduli District Council
Monduli District is one of the six districts of Arusha Region in Tanzania. It is located in the northeastern part of the country. This district borders the country of Kenya to the north; to the east, it borders Kilimanjaro Region and Arumeru District; to the south, it borders Manyara Region; and to the west, it borders Ngorongoro District and Karatu District. Monduli Town is the administrative headquarters of the district.
﻿ According to the 2002 National Census of Tanzania, the residents of Monduli District were 185,237. The name Monduli comes from the Monduli Juu Ward. It is said that there was a wealthy Maasai elder named Monduli who lived in that area during the German colonial period. The Germans ruled Tanzania in the 1880s and also introduced a European education system that taught subjects such as science, mathematics, engineering, and even the German language. Tanzania gained independence on December 9, 1961, under the leadership of the first President, Julius Nyerere.
pages.text_sw:
Historia ya Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Monduli
Wilaya ya Monduli ni mojawapo ya wilaya sita za Mkoa wa Arusha Region nchini Tanzania. Iko katika sehemu ya kaskazini mashariki ya nchi. Wilaya hii inapakana na nchi ya Kenya upande wa kaskazini; upande wa mashariki inapakana na Kilimanjaro Region pamoja na Wilaya ya Arumeru District; upande wa kusini inapakana na Manyara Region; na upande wa magharibi inapakana na Wilaya za Ngorongoro District na Karatu District. Mji wa Monduli Town ndio makao makuu ya kiutawala ya wilaya.
Kwa mujibu wa Sensa ya Taifa ya mwaka 2002 ya Tanzania, wakazi wa Wilaya ya Monduli walikuwa 185,237. Jina Monduli linatokana na Kata ya Monduli Juu. Inasemekana kuwa kulikuwa na babu tajiri wa Kimaasai aliyeitwa Monduli ambaye aliishi katika eneo hilo wakati wa ukoloni wa Wajerumani. Wajerumani waliitawala Tanzania katika miaka ya 1880, na waliinza pia mfumo wa elimu ya Ulaya uliokuwa ukifundisha masomo kama sayansi, hisabati, uhandisi na hata lugha ya Kijerumani. Tanzania ilipata uhuru tarehe 9 Desemba 1961 chini ya uongozi wa Rais wa kwanza, Julius Nyerere.

pages.title: Ngorongoro District Council
pages.text_en:
Origin of the area.
Ngorongoro District Council is one of the seven councils located in Arusha Region, Tanzania. The District Headquarters is in Loliondo Wasso, approximately 400 kilometers from the Regional Headquarters. This district was established in 1979 under Act No. 5 of the Local Government Authorities Act of 1982, having three divisions: Loliondo, Sale, and Ngorongoro. The Ngorongoro division is located within the Ngorongoro Conservation Area (NCA), which was established under Act Cap 413 of 1959 (NCA, CAP 284 (R.E.2002)).
Borders of the Administrative Area.
Ngorongoro District borders the neighboring country of Kenya to the North, Serengeti District to the West, Monduli and Longido Districts to the East, and Karatu District to the South.
Area Size
Ngorongoro District has an area of approximately 14,036 square kilometers which lies between 3°30’ south of the Equator and 35°42’ east of Greenwich, with an altitude of 1,009 to 3,645 meters above sea level.
Weather conditions of the District: The Ngorongoro District has warm areas, especially in the Sale Ward, and a tropical climate. It experiences average rainfall of 800mm to 1,000mm and strong winds blowing from the East to the West. Large areas of the District have natural forests, mainly of the Acacia species, especially in the Central, Eastern, and Western zones. The Eastern and Western sides have a Rift Valley zone and large forests. The Southern part of the District is a famous area of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, taking up 59% of the district and located in a single ward of Ngorongoro.
﻿Native Vegetation
The district has four (4) registered natural forests which are:-
Loliondo I Forest which is managed.
Loliondo II Forest which is managed.
Sariani Community Forest.
Ngorongoro Highlands Forest.
pages.text_sw:
Chimbuko la eneo.
Halmashauri ya Wilaya Ngorongoro ni mojawapo kati ya Halmashauri saba zilizopo katika Mkoa wa Arusha nchini Tanzania. Makao Makuu ya Wilaya yapo Loliondo Wasso umbali wa takribani kilomita 400 kutoka Makao Makuu ya Mkoa. Wilaya hii ilianzishwa mwaka 1979 chini ya sheria namba 5 ya Mamlaka za Serikali za Mitaa ya Mwaka 1982 ikiwa na Tarafa tatu za Loliondo, Sale na Ngorongoro. Tarafa ya Ngorongoro imo kwenye eneo la Hifadhi ya Ngorongoro (NCA) iliyoanzishwa kwa Sheria Sura 413 ya mwaka1959 (NCA, CAP 284 (R.E.2002).
Mipaka ya Eneo la Utawala.
Wilaya ya Ngorongoro inapakana na Nchi jirani ya Kenya kwa upande wa Kaskazini, Wilaya ya Serengeti kwa upande wa Magharibi, Wilaya za Monduli na Longido kwa upande wa Mashariki na Wilaya ya Karatu kwa upande wa Kusini.
Ukubwa wa Eneo
Wilaya ya Ngorongoro ina eneo la kilometa za mraba zipatazo 14,036 ambalo lipo katika nyuzi 30030’ kusini mwa Ikweta na 35042’ Mashariki mwa Greenwich na urefu wa mita 1,009 hadi 3,645 kutoka usawa wa bahari.
Hali ya hewa ya Wilaya:-
Wilaya ya Ngorongoro ina maeneo ya joto la washastani hasa katika Tarafa ya Sale na hali ya Kitropikali, ina mvua za wastani wa 800mm hadi 1,000mm na upepo mkali unaovuma kutoka Mashariki kuelekea Magharibi. Maeneo makubwa ya Wilaya yana uoto wa asili jamii ya Akashia hasa ukanda wa Kati, Mashariki na Magharibi. Upande wa Mashariki na Magharibi kuna Ukanda wa bonde la Ufa na misitu Mkubwa. Upande wa Kusini mwa Wilaya ni eneo maarufu la Hifadhi ya Ngorongoro linalochukua asilimia 59 ya wilaya ambalo lipo katika Tarafa moja ya Ngorongoro.
Uoto wa Asili
Wilaya ina misitu minne (4) ya asili iliyosajiliwa ambayo ni:-
Msitu wa Loliondo I unaosimamiwa.
Msitu wa Loliondo II unaosimamiwa.
Msitu wa Jamii wa Sariani.
Msitu wa nyanda za Juu Ngorongoro "Ngorongoro Highlind Forest" .

pages.title: Longido District Council
pages.text_en:
History
Longido District is one of the districts of Arusha Region, in northern Tanzania, officially established in 2007 after being split from Monduli District. The district borders Kenya to the northeast through the Namanga international border, which is a major gateway for trade and transportation between Tanzania and Kenya. Longido District is located in the northern part of Tanzania and lies along Mount Longido, among areas that are famous for their natural and historical significance to the Maasai community.
The area of Longido District covers approximately 7,885 square kilometers. The climate is arid and the average rainfall is low, which makes the main economic activity natural livestock keeping, practiced by the Maasai community. This livestock keeping involves cattle, goats, and sheep, and it greatly contributes to the income and livelihoods of the people of Longido. However, in recent years, efforts have been made to promote irrigation farming and horticulture, especially in water-abundant areas such as Ketumbeine and Engarenaibor.
Longido District has a total of 20 wards, which are: Longido, Engikaret, Kimokouwa, Olmolog, Orbomba, Tingatinga, Gelai Lumbwa, Gelai Meirugoi, Ketumbeine, Elang’ata Dapash, Engarenaibor, Magadini, Kamwanga, Matale, Mundarara, Oltepesi, Sinoni, Ngereyani, Namanga, and Ilorienito. In each ward, there are villages with village government leadership, which collaborate with the district government to manage the development of the citizens. Its border with Kenya through Namanga makes Longido an important place for cross-border trade, tourism, and minor social and economic diplomatic activities.
Longido District has health infrastructure that includes a district hospital which exists and provides all essential services to the citizens. This hospital has modern equipment and personnel specialized in various medical fields. Besides that hospital, the district has a number of health centers and dispensaries that provide basic services to the community in rural areas. The district government, in collaboration with development partners, has been improving health services and increasing the availability of medicines and friendly services for mothers and children.
In terms of education, Longido District has many primary and secondary schools, built through collaboration between the government, parents, and development stakeholders. These schools have continued to increase due to the demand for education among children from pastoralist communities, who previously lacked the opportunity to access education because of a nomadic lifestyle. The government has put in place robust strategies to ensure education reaches all children, including free primary education and the improvement of learning environments, especially for girls.
Apart from social and economic activities, Longido District is fortunate to have unique tourist attractions. Among these attractions are Mount Longido, the Enduimet Wildlife Sanctuary which is part of the elephant migration route from Amboseli (Kenya) to Tarangire National Park, beautiful natural scenery, and the Maasai culture, which attracts visitors from various parts of the world. Tourists are drawn to the traditional life of the Maasai community, their traditional clothing, traditional dances, and their system of customary leadership. Customary leaders such as Laigwanans and elders hold significant positions in the community and in preserving the traditional order of life
﻿ Overall, the history of Longido District is built on the foundations of Maasai culture, social and economic development efforts, and unique geographical environments that provide its residents the opportunity to participate in various activities including livestock keeping, cross-border trade, tourism, and education. The Longido District Government, in collaboration with citizens and development stakeholders, continues to build a strong foundation for sustainable and democratic development to ensure a better life for the residents of Longido.
pages.text_sw:
Historia
Wilaya ya Longido ni mojawapo ya wilaya za Mkoa wa Arusha, kaskazini mwa Tanzania, iliyoanzishwa rasmi mwaka 2007 baada ya kugawanywa kutoka Wilaya ya Monduli. Wilaya hii inapakana na Kenya upande wa kaskazini mashariki kupitia mpaka wa kimataifa wa Namanga, ambayo ni lango kuu la biashara na usafirishaji baina ya Tanzania na Kenya. Wilaya ya Longido ipo katika eneo la kaskazini mwa Tanzania na inapatikana kando ya Mlima wa Longido, miongoni mwa maeneo maarufu ya asili na kihistoria kwa jamii ya Kimasai.
Eneo la Wilaya ya Longido lina ukubwa wa takribani kilomita za mraba 7,885. Hali ya hewa ni ya ukame na wastani wa mvua ni mdogo, hali inayofanya shughuli kuu ya kiuchumi kuwa ni ufugaji wa asili, unaofanywa na jamii ya Wamasai. Ufugaji huu unahusisha ng’ombe, mbuzi, na kondoo, na unachangia pakubwa kipato na maisha ya wananchi wa Longido. Hata hivyo, kwa miaka ya hivi karibuni, jitihada zimekuwa zikifanyika kuhamasisha kilimo cha umwagiliaji na bustani hasa katika maeneo yenye maji kama vile Ketumbeine na Engarenaibor.
Wilaya ya Longido ina jumla ya kata 20 ambazo ni: Longido, Engikaret, Kimokouwa, Olmolog, Orbomba, Tingatinga, Gelai Lumbwa, Gelai Meirugoi, Ketumbeine, Elang’ata Dapash, Engarenaibor, Magadini, Kamwanga, Matale, Mundarara
, Oltepesi, Sinoni, Ngereyani, Namanga, na Ilorienito. Katika kila kata kuna vijiji vyenye uongozi wa serikali ya kijiji, ambavyo vinashirikiana na serikali ya wilaya kusimamia maendeleo ya wananchi. Mpaka wake na Kenya kupitia Namanga huifanya Longido kuwa sehemu muhimu kwa biashara za mpakani, utalii, na shughuli za kidiplomasia ndogo ndogo za kijamii na kiuchumi.
Wilaya ya Longido ina miundombinu ya afya inayojumuisha hospitali ya wilaya ambayo ipo na inatoa huduma zote muhimu kwa wananchi. Hospitali hii ina vifaa vya kisasa na wahudumu waliobobea katika fani mbalimbali za tiba. Mbali na hospitali hiyo, wilaya ina jumla ya vituo kadhaa vya afya na zahanati zinazotoa huduma za msingi kwa jamii katika maeneo ya vijijini. Serikali ya wilaya kwa kushirikiana na wadau wa maendeleo imekuwa ikiboresha huduma za afya na kuongeza upatikanaji wa dawa na huduma rafiki kwa akina mama na watoto.
Kwa upande wa elimu, Wilaya ya Longido ina shule nyingi za msingi na sekondari, zilizojengwa kwa ushirikiano kati ya serikali, wazazi, na wadau wa maendeleo. Shule hizi zimeendelea kuongezeka kutokana na uhitaji wa elimu kwa watoto wa jamii ya kifugaji, ambao awali walikosa fursa ya kupata elimu kutokana na mtindo wa maisha wa kuhamahama. Serikali imeweka mikakati madhubuti ya kuhakikisha elimu inawafikia watoto wote, ikiwemo elimu ya msingi bila malipo na uboreshaji wa mazingira ya kujifunzia hasa kwa wasichana.
Mbali na shughuli za kijamii na kiuchumi, Wilaya ya Longido imebahatika kuwa na vivutio vya kipekee vya kitalii. Miongoni mwa vivutio hivyo ni pamoja na Mlima Longido, hifadhi ya wanyamapori ya Enduimet ambayo ni sehemu ya usafiri wa tembo kutoka Amboseli (Kenya) hadi hifadhi ya Tarangire, mandhari nzuri ya asili, na utamaduni wa Kimasai ambao huvutia wageni kutoka sehemu mbalimbali duniani. Watalii huvutiwa na maisha ya jadi ya jamii ya Kimasai, mavazi yao ya asili, ngoma za asili, na mfumo wao wa uongozi wa kimila. Viongozi wa kimila kama Laigwanan na wazee wa mila wana nafasi kubwa katika jamii na katika kutunza utaratibu wa maisha na ardhi ya kijadi.
Kwa ujumla, historia ya Wilaya ya Longido imejengwa juu ya misingi ya utamaduni wa Kimasai, jitihada za maendeleo ya kijamii na kiuchumi, na mazingira ya kipekee ya kijiografia yanayowapa wakazi wake fursa ya kushiriki katika shughuli mbalimbali ikiwemo ufugaji, biashara ya mpakani, utalii na elimu. Serikali ya Wilaya ya Longido kwa kushirikiana na wananchi na wadau wa maendeleo inaendelea kujenga msingi imara wa maendeleo endelevu na ya kidemokrasia ili kuhakikisha maisha bora kwa wakazi wa Longido.
